title: Image Format
description: Frame filename pattern. % is replaced with the frame number. e.g. "gif-%.png"

title: Image Count
description: Total number of frames. Must match the number of files in ./images/

title: Image Key
description: Beat keyframe mapping (comma-separated). Single value = full loop mode. Multi-value = beat segment mode. e.g. "0,8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64,72"

title: User Offset [ms]
description: Animation timing offset in milliseconds. Positive = delay, Negative = advance. Can also be adjusted with +/- keys.

title: Snap Divisor
description: Beat subdivision. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8. (1=1/1 beat, 2=1/2 beat, 4=1/4 beat, etc.) Can also be adjusted with [ / ] keys.
